mapper.select: SELECT t.id AS tagId, t.name AS tagName, t.color AS color, COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN a.type = 0 THEN a.amount WHEN a.type = 1 THEN a.amount ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS totalAmount, COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) AS transactionCount, COALESCE( COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) * 100.0 / NULLIF( (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account_book a2 WHERE a2.user_id = #{userId} AND a2.is_deleted = 0 AND YEAR(a2.account_date) = #{year} AND MONTH(a2.account_date) = #{month}), 0 ), 0 ) AS percentage FROM tag t LEFT JOIN account_tag at ON t.id = at.tag_id LEFT JOIN account_book a ON at.account_id = a.id AND a.user_id = #{userId} AND a.is_deleted = 0 AND YEAR(a.account_date) = #{year} AND MONTH(a.account_date) = #{month} WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY t.id, t.name, t.color ORDER BY totalAmount DESC
